lines: Completely unaware of being targeted by the Nisha family underboss, Kuroki Shizukuー
I had just bumped into Sakura coming out of the house as I was returning from my ice cream trip with Hebiko.

Ever since the whole interdimensional incident, Sakura had taken it upon herself to become a freeloader at my place. And she already seems to have grown quite accustomed to it judging from her "welcome back" just now.
Sakura looked up happily in the rays of the steadily growing afternoon sunlight.
And where are you off to?
A hot day calls for a trip to the pool! C'mon Fuma-kun, get a move on!
With that, she yanked my arm without so much as hearing my reply.
Huh!? I don't want to. I just got home from school.
When I reflexively pulled away, Sakura's eyes widened in surprise, as if she'd never expected to be refused.
What the heck is that!? You've got cute Sakura-chan inviting you and immediately refuse? That's so mean!
I've been training my ass off all morning.
Alright, then the afternoon should be underwater combat training♪
No, it's not "alright." You think we can do that in a regular public pool?
Then let's go for a plain old swim. I'll treat you to some yakisoba and a cola at the poolside!
Yakisoba and cola at the poolside, huh? Well, I'd be lying if I said that doesn't sound good...
I knooow, right? Hop to it, Fuma-kun! Summer'll end if you don't hurry up!
Boo～～～!! Why're you being such a downer!? And here I was waiting for you to come home!!
I was! Me, the beautiful Sakura-chan. Aren't you happy?
You're a freeloader, so you're here whenever I'm home. I'm already too used to seeing you.
Sakura stamped her feet in frustration.
And wouldn't the pool be a bad idea?
What will you do if you run into the grown-up Sakura-sensei or Headmistress Asagi?
It's fine～ I told you, there's no such thing as a time paradox or dimensional collapse. Have you ever seen them actually happen?
Sakura playfully waved her hand as she chuckled.
That's not really what I'm worried about.
This younger Sakura had been sent here from another dimension that corresponded to our world's past, except theirs is a past in which personal relationships and events differ.
It was because of something called the Brain Flayer, an octopus-like extra-dimentional being.
And, she'd been stuck in our world since we killed it.
At the time, I myself had been sent to younger Sakura's world, in other words, another dimension with our past, but slightly different.
There I found Rinko-senpai in the same boat as I was, and she told me, to my surprise, that she had run into her younger self and had been living with her for a while.
However, nothing had happened to Rinko-senpai even though she'd met her younger self.
On the contrary, she said she had no memories of having met her older selfーor anyone who looked like herーwhen she was little.
That is to say, whether or not they were the same person, past or future, different dimensions were in fact different. And they didn't appear to affect one another.
That said, it was also possible that we were simply incapable of recognizing it even if some alteration occurred to the world or someone who was supposed to exist was actually missing.
But the actual problem that would come before any such science fiction was the "complication" that would be caused when this freeloader Sakura met Headmistress Asagi or Sakura-sensei.
That would definitely lead to another sort of commotion that would be nothing but trouble.
Even the easygoing younger Sakura was on the same page on that point.
Nevertheless, it would be just a matter of time before the freeloader Sakura was found out, much like when Yukikaze had learned about her from Rinko-senpai.
Come on, let's go, Fuma-kun! Let's gooo!
Undeterred, Sakura tugged my arm again.
The pool is a bad idea after all. It's too crowded.
Then the river! Let's go to the mountains and enjoy the river! We should be fine there!
Well, if it's just the river in the mountains, there wouldn't be a problem...
Right!? And if I hide in your shadow until we arrive, no one will see me!
But it's hot... and I just came back, you know...
Please! It's a once in a lifetime request!!
Then she slapped her hands together and began to beg me.
How many lives do you even have, huh?
Don't you worry about that. I have a long life after all!
You know that doesn't make any sense, right?
Pretty pleeeease. I'm so hot I'm about to diiieee!
Then stay in an air-conditioned room. That's my plan, anyway.
Mmnahh～!! I wanna splash around in the water like you're supposed to in summer!
I wanna swim I wanna swim I wanna swi～m!!
Guess I have no choice. Then you'll do my cleaning duty for three days.
Seeing my face become grim, Sakura spoke without a moment's delay.
Plus, when we get back, I'll return "SEKIRONIN" to you until tomorrow,  Fuma-kun!
It seemed like she wanted to go pretty badly.
Sakura smiled broadly and raised both hands up high.
And so, even though I'd just returned home, I ended up having to go to the river with Sakura.
Away from Gosha Village's urban area, deep in the mountains that surrounded the village like a wall, there soared an enormous castle.
It was the mansion of the Mizuki Family, known both for being a prestigious Taimanin family and for having once made their fortune in the financial industry.
In the spacious courtyard just outside the moat to prevent enemy invasion stood Kuroki Shizuku.
He had suddenly emerged from the shadow of beautifully tended garden trees.
Shizuku exclaimed in shock at the sight of the European-esque scenery stretching out before him.
Is that a castle? I just wanted to go to Gosha Village, but look what I found...
The view was so surreal that he couldn't help but tilt his head in bewilderment. And yet he was amused as well.
I never knew they had a castle like this. The Taimanin village is full of mysteries.
I wonder if there's a princess in there?
There must be a secret chamber deep inside too, with lots of treasure hidden within and guards to protect it.
Shizuku muttered to himself in amusement as he looked up at the castle.
Suddenly, a voice called out to Shizuku from behind him.
Even more amused, Shizuku turned around to face the man who'd approached him without revealing his presence.
I'm Taimanin Library, a guard of Gosha.
Library's tone was calm and collected.
After he finished training Kotaro earlier, Library had been patrolling around Gosha Village as an Oniwaban, leading other Fuma ninja who had pledged allegiance to their young master.
He believed it was his duty as an Oniwaban not only to protect the Fuma head family but also to guard Gosha and earn the trust of its residents.
Indeed. And you're an intruder, are you not?
Your ki told me you were.
My ki? Huh, how's it feel?
Hmm, like the sea at night. It's dark and deep.
The two opposing figures were in stark contrast to each other.
Shizuku was bluntly displaying his innocent curiosity like a child who'd found a new toy.
Library, on the other hand, didn't give off any emotions like the undisturbed surface of the water.
Library's subordinates, the Fuma Oniwaban, had appeared from nowhere like a gust of wind and taken up their position to cut off Shizuku's retreat.
There's something I want to ask you.
Some Taimanin guards were found dead behind the school. And a boy like you was spotted at the scene.
That's a secret. And I don't like tattling.
Then let me ask about you. Just who are you?
Shizuku revealed his identity without even the slightest hesitation.
Kuroki? I see. One of the Nisha's Jonin. I know the previous head of your family well, but you seem to have a little different air from his.
There was a hint of surprise mixed in Library's voice as he answered.
Shizuku also opened his eyes wide without hiding his surprise.
Whoa, you know my father mister!?
Somewhat. Hmm, so you're his son.
Alright mister machine man, are you familiar with the Fuma? If so, do you know Fuma Kotaro?
What business do you have with him?
Library's tone was unchanged, but his eyes gleamed sharply beneath his iron mask.
As if he'd realized this, Shizuku replied gleefully.
I'm gonna kill the Master Diot. Gaiza-sama will acknowledge me then, won't he?
He'll know I'm much more useful than Sho-nii and old Yao Bikuni.
I'm surprised. To think a boy like you is an assassin.
As if the veil of serenity had been lifted in one breath, the murderous aura began to swirl around Library and the Fuma Oniwaban.
Wow, so you are working for the Master Diot! Now it's getting interesting!
